prompt: Some people think that children should not watch telvision as it has negative effects while some people believe that they should watch television as it helps them in their future. Discuss both views and give your opinion
essay:
There is a debate over whether allowing children to watch television has negative or positive effects on them. Although it can distract young people from important tasks and make them more introverted, I believe they can learn valuable lessons from programmes, while also remaining safe when their parents are busy. Therefore, its benefits outweigh its drawbacks.

On the one hand, watching TV can distract pupils from completing other important tasks. Since it is highly entertaining and they are not responsible enough to prioritise their duties, they may prefer it. Consequently, it can be a burden for parents to convince them to do their homework or household chores. Moreover, some youngsters may become addicted to television and spend more time in front of the screen than participating in activities with their friends and family. This can make them more introverted and prevent them from developing social skills. For instance, due to the variety of content available nowadays, many parents limit their offspring’s screen time to minimise the risk of addiction.

On the other hand, television can keep youngsters occupied while their parents or caregivers are busy, reducing the need for constant supervision and keeping them away from potential physical dangers. Furthermore, many programmes are designed to educate children while entertaining them. Much of this content contains hidden messages and life lessons about appropriate behaviour and distinguishing right from wrong. Other shows are educational and introduce them to new vocabulary, colours, animals and numbers. For example, many parents play Ms Rachel for their one- or two-year-old children to help them learn simple words such as “mom” and “dad”, as well as colours and animal names.

To conclude, although excessive screen time can distract youngsters from their responsibilities and hinder their social development, I believe that television can be beneficial when their viewing is properly controlled, as it can provide education, entertainment and a safe way to keep them occupied.
